start_time_note: One race per class and round (Race number in time order); one row per boat that rode the round, in bayak.com rank order. bayak.com prints only the round each boat reached: a boat is written in every round up to it (K1 Men/Women: Preliminary, Quarterfinal, Semifinal, Final; C1, K1 Junior Men/Women, OC1, K1 Squirt Men: Preliminary, Semifinal, Final; K1 Squirt Women: Preliminary, Final). Heat membership and the number of rides are not published (gap results_missing), so a round is one race and each row is the boat's start in that round, not each ride. Times: the revised programme's slot for the round (heat time where the programme gives the round its own slot: semifinals and finals); the day's block start for prelims, quarterfinals and the squirt semifinal (block).
